semantics.definition: The Mannequin, a character of the old No Origins project, made with Meshy.ai: its model and its look, as small copies.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one the mannequin every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Be a person in the 3D world.
